h1: Type 2 diabetes treatments: how treatment is chosen, step by step, in current guidelines
dek: Type 2 diabetes treatment starts with nutrition, activity and education, adds medicines chosen by heart, kidney and weight goals, and moves to injections such as GLP-1 drugs and insulin when needed. This is the sequence the 2026 ADA Standards describe.
scope: Informational. Describes how guidelines sequence treatment; no personal treatment advice.
